decisions.reason: As a flagship product line tightly tied to the firm’s core software and strategic move toward digital practice workflows, management would likely keep it unless results were clearly below aspiration for several periods.

The analytics dashboard builds directly on existing software, customer data, and integration capabilities, so a growing firm with R&D and some slack would usually continue it while learning about adoption.

A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and strengthens the core value proposition, making withdrawal unlikely unless uptake is distinctly disappointing relative to aspirations.

Because the portal is relatively distant from the firm’s main software business and appears less central than other launches, management would be more likely to redeploy resources if its performance did not clearly justify continuation.
